cards.ex: After losing his job, he was really hard up for a few months.
cards.exUz: Ishidan ayrilganidan keyin, u bir necha oy davomida juda qiyin ahvolda edi.
cards.uzDef: Pul yetishmasligi, moddiy qiyinchilikda bo'lish.

cards.ex: With the recession looming, the government decided to tighten the purse strings.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiy tanazzul yaqinlashayotgani sababli, hukumat xarajatlarni qisqartirishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Xarajatlarni kamaytirish, pulni tejashga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: His parents footed the bill for his college education.
cards.exUz: Uning ota-onasi kollej ta'limi uchun to'lovni amalga oshirdi.
cards.uzDef: Xarajatlarni qoplash, to'lovni to'lash.

cards.ex: She was born with a silver spoon in her mouth and never had to worry about money.
cards.exUz: U oltin qoshiqda tug'ilgan va hech qachon pul haqida tashvishlanmagan.
cards.uzDef: Boy oilada tug'ilgan, imtiyozli sharoitda ulg'aygan.

cards.ex: Many farmers in the region scrape a living from the land.
cards.exUz: Hududdagi ko'plab fermerlar yerdan zo'rg'a kun kechirishadi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchilik bilan yetarli daromad topish, zo'rg'a yashash.

cards.ex: They are comfortably well-off and can afford to travel frequently.
cards.exUz: Ular to'kin-sochin yashashadi va tez-tez sayohat qilishga qurbi yetadi.
cards.uzDef: Moliyaviy jihatdan yaxshi ta'minlangan, yetarli mablag'ga ega.

cards.ex: The country is implementing an austerity program to reduce its debt.
cards.exUz: Mamlakat qarzini kamaytirish uchun tejamkorlik dasturini amalga oshirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Davlat xarajatlarini qisqartirishga qaratilgan siyosat.

cards.ex: Lack of education and opportunity can lead to a poverty trap.
cards.exUz: Ta'lim va imkoniyatlarning yetishmasligi qashshoqlik tuzog'iga olib kelishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Qashshoqlikdan qutulishning qiyinligi, doimiy qashshoqlik holati.

cards.ex: Education is key to improving social mobility.
cards.exUz: Ta'lim ijtimoiy harakatchanlikni yaxshilashning asosiy omilidir.
cards.uzDef: Ijtimoiy holatning yaxshilanishi, qashshoqlikdan boylikka o'tish.

cards.ex: We need to create a level playing field for all businesses.
cards.exUz: Biz barcha bizneslar uchun teng imkoniyatlar yaratishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hamma uchun teng sharoitlar yaratish.

cards.ex: He tried to make a quick buck by selling fake merchandise.
cards.exUz: U soxta mahsulotlarni sotish orqali oson pul topishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va osonlik bilan pul topish.

cards.ex: After being laid off, he was on the dole for several months.
cards.exUz: Ishdan bo'shatilgandan keyin, u bir necha oy davomida nafaqa oldi.
cards.uzDef: Işsizlik nafaqasi olib yashash.

cards.ex: They live in the lap of luxury with a mansion and a private jet.
cards.exUz: Ular hashamatli uy va shaxsiy samolyot bilan dabdabada yashashadi.
cards.uzDef: Hashamatli va qulay sharoitlarda yashash.

cards.ex: The gap between the haves and have-nots is widening.
cards.exUz: Boylar va kambag'allar o'rtasidagi tafovut kengayib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatdagi boy va kambag'al qatlamlar.

cards.ex: Many families have fallen on hard times due to the economic crisis.
cards.exUz: Ko'plab oilalar iqtisodiy inqiroz tufayli qiyin ahvolga tushib qolishdi.
cards.uzDef: Moliyaviy qiyinchiliklarga duch kelish, daromadni yo'qotish.

cards.ex: They have to get by on a very small pension.
cards.exUz: Ular juda kichik pensiya bilan kun kechirishlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: Oz miqdordagi pul yoki resurs bilan yashash.

cards.ex: The government needs to show fiscal responsibility.
cards.exUz: Hukumat moliyaviy mas'uliyatni ko'rsatishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Pulni to'g'ri va mas'uliyat bilan boshqarish.

cards.ex: He comes from a well-to-do family and has never had to worry about money.
cards.exUz: U badavlat oiladan chiqqan va hech qachon pul haqida tashvishlanmagan.
cards.uzDef: Moliyaviy jihatdan ta'minlangan, boy oila.

cards.ex: The silver lining of the recession is that people are saving more money.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiy tanazzulning yaxshi tomoni shundaki, odamlar ko'proq pul tejashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda ham yaxshi natijaga umid qilish.

cards.ex: Millions of people in the world live on the poverty line.
cards.exUz: Dunyo bo'ylab millionlab odamlar qashshoqlik chegarasida yashaydi.
cards.uzDef: Qashshoqlik chegarasida yashash, minimal daromadga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: The program aims to help economically disadvantaged youth find employment.
cards.exUz: Dastur iqtisodiy nochor yoshlarga ish topishga yordam berishga qaratilgan.
cards.uzDef: Iqtisodiy jihatdan qiyin ahvolda bo'lgan, yetarli daromadi yo'q.

cards.ex: He ran up huge debts after losing his job.
cards.exUz: Ishini yo'qotgandan keyin u katta qarzlarga botdi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p miqdorda qarz yig'ish.

cards.ex: Advocates are pushing for a living wage for all workers.
cards.exUz: Himoyachilar barcha ishchilar uchun tirikchilik maoshini targ'ib qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kun kechirish uchun yetarli bo'lgan minimal ish haqi.

cards.ex: The authorities often turn a blind eye to corruption.
cards.exUz: Hokimiyat ko'pincha korrupsiyaga ko'rmaslikka oladi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri ishga qarshi choralar ko'rmaslik.

cards.ex: The wealthy elite control a large portion of the country's resources.
cards.exUz: Badavlat elita mamlakat resurslarining katta qismini nazorat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatdagi eng boy va nufuzli shaxslar.

cards.ex: Luxury goods are often sold at a premium.
cards.exUz: Hashamatli tovarlar ko'pincha yuqori narxda sotiladi.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy narxdan yuqori narxda sotiladigan.

cards.ex: After her husband lost his job, she became the breadwinner.
cards.exUz: Eri ishini yo'qotgandan keyin, u oilani boquvchiga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Oila uchun pul topadigan asosiy shaxs.

cards.ex: It took them years to get out of debt.
cards.exUz: Ularga qarzlardan qutulish uchun yillar kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qarzlarni to'lab, qarzdan xalos bo'lish.

cards.ex: It's always good to have a rainy day fund.
cards.exUz: Doimo qora kun uchun jamg'arma bo'lishi yaxshi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan xarajatlar uchun yig'ilgan pul.

cards.ex: Social stratification can limit opportunities for those at the bottom.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy tabaqalanish pastdagilar uchun imkoniyatlarni cheklashi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatning turli ijtimoiy tabaqalarga bo'linishi.
